About this site

This site describes the Crimes - 2001 to Present (City of Chicago), published by City of Chicago, Chicago Police Department. It is generated from the repository pdt-chicago-crimes, which holds metadata built from the publisher's documentation: each variable's label, question text, codes and missing codes, and availability, with corrections and links between releases. Each fact says where it came from.

What it isn't

  • It isn't the publisher's site, and the publisher hasn't reviewed it. The publisher's own page for the dataset is https://data.cityofchicago.org/d/ijzp-q8t2. Where this site and the publisher's documentation differ, the publisher's documentation is the source; the differences this repository knows of are listed as corrections.
  • It doesn't hold the data. The data come from the publisher, or from this repository's data release when the terms allow; see Getting the data.
  • It makes no analysis decisions: which answers count as agreement, which weights or cases to use, or how to recode. Those belong to the projects that use the data.

Terms of use

This site provides applications using data that has been modified for use from its original source, www.cityofchicago.org, the official website of the City of Chicago. The City of Chicago makes no claims as to the content, accuracy, timeliness, or completeness of any of the data provided at this site. The data provided at this site is subject to change at any time. What they say
Allen Downey decided on 2026-11-19 that data, documentation and metadata ship and that LLM processing is allowed, with the City's disclaimer as the notice. Users should heed the description's warning that the data "should not be used for comparison purposes over time". The City of Chicago's Terms of Use (data disclaimer) say the City "voluntarily provides the data on this website as a service to the public", "as is", and may require a user "to terminate any and all display, distribution or other use" of the data. Anyone offering "any software application, or other secondary or derivative application using data supplied at this website" must include the City's disclaimer (quoted on that page) and comply with any additional terms of the agency providing the data. Users indemnify the City. The dataset's own description adds the Chicago Police Department's disclaimer, says the data "should not be used for comparison purposes over time", and prohibits attempts "to derive specific addresses". Nothing addresses LLM processing. The portal labels the license "See Terms of Use".

PublicDataToolkit

The library and the standard that build this site: https://github.com/AllenDowney/PublicDataToolkit. This site was generated by version 0.1.0.

Reporting an error

  • In the publisher's documentation (a wrong label, a missing code, question text that belongs to another item): open an issue at the issue tracker of the repository pdt-chicago-crimes, with where you found it. This repository records such errors as corrections, with the evidence, and keeps the publisher's original; it also says whether the error was reported to the publisher.
  • In this repository's records (a wrong link, a code classified wrongly, a variable left out): open an issue at the issue tracker of the repository pdt-chicago-crimes.
  • To the publisher: City of Chicago, Chicago Police Department.
